states.name: out
states.meaning: 32-bit sticky capture register. For each bit i, out[i] becomes 1 after a sampled 1-to-0 transition on in[i] and remains 1 until the synchronous reset is sampled high.
states.update_time: posedge clk after sampled inputs have settled

states.name: prev_in
states.meaning: 32-bit internal history of the previous sampled in value, used to detect 1-to-0 transitions. It is updated to in after each posedge clk, including reset cycles.
states.update_time: posedge clk after sampled inputs have settled

rules.condition: reset == 1 at the active posedge clk sample; all bits of out become 0, independent of in and prior out. This has priority over the capture/hold rule.

On a posedge clk sample with reset == 0: for every bit i, out[i] <= out[i] OR (prev_in[i] AND NOT in[i]); after the edge, prev_in <= in for all 32 bits. Existing 1s are preserved, and a 1-to-0 transition on in[i] sets out[i] to 1 until reset.
rules.spec_quote: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first sampled posedge clk where reset == 0; from that edge onward reset no longer forces out to 0

mid: Optional mid input changes occur after the sampled posedge clk and before the next posedge; they are carried to the start of the next row and do not retroactively affect the already-sampled output.

uncertain.note: The public specification does not define whether a 1 sampled while reset is active should be retained as previous input for detecting a 1-to-0 transition after reset release. The current contract updates prev_in during reset cycles, so reset=1/in=1 followed by reset=0/in=0 captures out=1; clearing or suppressing prev_in during reset yields out=0.
candidates: prev_in is updated during reset cycles, so a 1 sampled under reset followed by a 0 after reset release captures out=1
prev_in history is cleared or suppressed while reset is active, so a 1 sampled under reset followed by a 0 after reset release does not capture out=1
